title: ADR-028 closeout: mark review-lens and review-report as migrated
goal: Fix ADR-028 and its guard test to reflect that review-lens and review-report ARE migrated to _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate, closing out the record left behind by #1840/#1843.

steps.description: Fix the guard test first (write RED, then fix to GREEN): update the header comment to describe review-lens as migrated (not the unmigrated counter-example); fix SPEC-3 to exclude comment lines when grepping for extract_first_json_object (use grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#') so it correctly takes the 'migrated' branch rather than matching the explanatory comment at plugin.sh:394; fix SPEC-2 to add review-lens and review-report to the loop, and to search all non-test .sh files under each plugin's directory tree (not only plugin.sh) so that review-report's parser in lib/lenses.sh is found. After writing these changes, the fixed SPEC-3 takes the 'migrated' branch unconditionally; the RED step is that prior to this fix the test matched a comment and took the wrong branch — state that in the PR body.

Amend ADR-028 §Migration: (1) in the Per-stage gates list (around line 181-185), add entries for _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok (review-lens) and _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok (review-report) with their gate criteria; (2) in the migration paragraph (around line 187), add review-lens and review-report to the migrated-stage list with a dated note citing #1840 and #1843; (3) replace the 'not migrated' paragraph (around line 189) with a dated correction note; (4) remove the false 'review-lens was not migrated' claim (around line 193). Preserve the 2026-09-02 correction note as history. Run npm test and npm run lint to confirm all green.

notes: All code is already correct — both plugins use _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate (review-lens at plugin.sh:398 via _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok; review-report at lib/lenses.sh:162 via _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok). Only two files change. The RED step for SPEC-3: before the fix, grep on plugin.sh matched the comment at line 394 (which mentions extract_first_json_object to explain why it was replaced), causing the test to take the 'not migrated' conditional branch entirely — the 'migrated' assertion never ran. After the fix (excluding comment lines), no match exists and the test unconditionally asserts the migrated state. SPEC-2's RED step: adding review-lens and review-report to the loop immediately exercises them; since the code is already migrated, SPEC-2 goes green on the first run after step-1 (no separate red step there). ADR-028 is checked against config/adr-enforcement-baseline.txt — if it is already grandfathered, no Enforced-by section is needed; if it is not grandfathered, a lint failure would require adding one. The prior plan assumed it is grandfathered; this should be verified before merging. review-report's lib/ directory contains no test .sh files, so the 'non-test .sh' search (excluding paths matching */tests/*) is unambiguous.
